title: Recolor Equipment & Stuffs
description: Some stuff match their gem colors with this pack
body:
If you feel iron block, iron tool, and iron equipment are too bright then this pack is your solution 

Notes: this is my first time making resources pack, so if I make any mistakes, please tell me

Credits: most of the textures are from Color Tweaks pack by Spryzeen

Chainmail armors textures are from Refined Armors pack by Vectorwing

Leather textures are from Vanilla Tweaks
